column5: components/ui/field.ts exports FIELD, MONO_FIELD, FIELD_AREA, MONO_AREA and FIELD_ROW; onboarding, sign-in, add-from-URL, discover, installed, presets, skills, config form, profile and quiet hours consume them, and no site appends a conflicting height or font size
